title: Redding Creek FSR 0252.05 (September 2, 2026)
source_text: Redding Creek FSR 0252.05 (September 2, 2026): Redding Creek FSR (east of Gray Creek pass) at 61.3km is closed until approximately September 4th, 2026, at 5pm for repairs. It will not be possible to travel from the east to west Kootenays via Gray Creek Pass until after September 4th 2026 at 5pm. Gray Creek FSR 0050.01 will remain open to the summit at approximately 16km.
